ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the RS2 Residential Single-Unit
(Detached House) District symbols as shown on Map No. 9-N

in the area bounded by:
A line 313.65 feet south of and parallel to West Irving Park Road; North Nordica
Avenue; a line 344.90 feet south of and parallel to West Irving Park Road; and the

public alley next west of and parallel to North Nordica Avenue.

To those of an RS3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District

SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common address of property: 3930 North Nordica Avenue, Chicago IL
